keyEvents.text: Goal! Boca Juniors 1, Independiente Rivadavia 0. Leandro Paredes (Boca Juniors) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Álex Arce (Independiente Rivadavia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Leandro Lozano (Boca Juniors) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Matías Fernández (Independiente Rivadavia).
Substitution, Boca Juniors. Williams Alarcón replaces Milton Delgado.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Boca Juniors 1, Independiente Rivadavia 0.
Second Half begins Boca Juniors 1, Independiente Rivadavia 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Williams Alarcón (Boca Juniors).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Boca Juniors. Alan Velasco replaces Williams Alarcón because of an injury.
Goal! Boca Juniors 2, Independiente Rivadavia 0. Miguel Merentiel (Boca Juniors) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Leandro Lozano with a cross.
Sheyko Studer (Independiente Rivadavia) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Independiente Rivadavia. Fabrizio Sartori replaces Rodrigo Atencio.
Substitution, Independiente Rivadavia. Matías Reali replaces Luis Sequeira.
